5. Record actual result and publish the upgrade controls through required PR

## U64 evidence and recovery

Source PR 64 has two exact-head R08 approvals, owner acceptance, verified merge
tree equality and green main CI; links are in the
[existing delivery receipt](../reviews/WB62-P01.md#r08-acceptance-and-merge-reconciliation).
That source review does not substitute for this project upgrade assessment.
Candidate preparation is verified UPGRADE_CURRENT; normal cutover is NOT_RUN.
Final package checks and exact reviewer receipts will be recorded in U64-S01.

Recovery checkpoint U64-PREP: old pin and normal runtime retained; no external
write or destructive effect occurred. Initial control reconciliation used a
candidate label beside exact reviewer hashes; the lifecycle check rejected it.
Replacing the label with the actual reviewed SHA restored consistency. Installer
preflight then required code-formatted `None`, matching its valid manifest
template/parser; the live field was corrected without changing its meaning.
These are ADOPTION-layer agent record errors, not a demonstrated source gap;
reporting NOT_REQUIRED. A sandbox denial on installer-owned files was resolved
through scoped execution approval; no permission boundary was bypassed. No
transient retries or review rounds were spent on these corrections. Owner is
the coordinator; next action is package validation/review, old pin remains safe.

The first assessment placement hit SDD_BATCH_HASH because WB62 still binds U84
at the generated default path. That rejected edit was restored exactly; the
project registry's versioned assessment location now preserves the bound input.
Likewise a runtime pin is normative, not an enumerated control delta: the
proposed historical-reference migration above requires U64 acceptance rather
than silently broadening the checker. No new upstream defect is asserted from
these correct preservation checks; reporting NOT_REQUIRED for this reconciliation.
